newsitem.title: UK: PRESS DIGEST - London Evening Standard - Jan 21.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - London Evening Standard - Jan 21.

text.p: Prepared for Reuters by The Broadcast Monitoring Company

The Equal Opportunities Commission said it will take women until 2040 to achieve equal pay unless employers adopt their new code equal pay practice which comes it effect on 26 March. EOC's chairwoman Kamlesh Bahl said despite 20 years of the Equal Pay Act there is still a 20 percent disparity in pay between men and women.
CALL FOR PROBE INTO PR FIRMS' BID FEES

The Takeover Panel is being requested by senior pension fund managers to force public relations firms advising on takeover bids to disclose fees. The issue was brought to light by the recent controversial take-over of Northern Electric by CalEnergy and the purchase of shares by BZW.
OZ BANK CHIEF ON TNT OPTIONS CHARGES

The executive director of McQuarie Bank, Simon Hannes, has been arrested on charges of breaching financial transactions law. There is speculation he could be the mystery options trader involved in last year's RTZ-CRA merger.
HARVEY NICKS CHIEF FACES NEW YORK FIGHT

Dickson Concepts, owner of Harvey Nichols, could face competition in its bid for troubled New York chain store Barney's despite a guaranteed rescue bid. Saks Holdings is believed to have approached the store.
